name: Small prime primitive roots for twelve prime moduli
description: construct() -> twelve Python prime integers, one for each modulus [101,103,107,109,113,127,131,137,139,149,151,157]. Each root is at most 100000, coprime to its modulus, and has multiplicative order p-1. Minimize the sum of these prime roots. Twelve small fixed moduli provide a finite construction/rediscovery instance; exact orders are verified without reproducing the shifted sieve.

sources.locator: Greg Martin, The Least Prime Primitive Root and the Shifted Sieve (1997). Author abstract and journal metadata inspected. The paper bounds least prime primitive roots and explicitly distinguishes unconditional almost-all-modulus and conditional all-modulus results. Twelve small fixed moduli provide a finite construction/rediscovery instance; exact orders are verified without reproducing the shifted sieve.
